notes: Asking price appears in two places: in the hero section as a text block (e.g. 'Price: $90,000!' or 'Price: {Confidential - Request Info}') and in the Additional Information status-box with the label 'Price:' next to a value div. The structured label 'Price:' inside the status-box (div.status-box div.details div.head with text 'Price:') is the most reliable location. However, the status-box value consistently shows 'Confidential [Request Info]' even when a real price is shown in the hero, so the hero text_block with id text_block-7-247 or text_block-8-247 may carry the actual figure. Revenue and cash flow are never shown as labeled structured fields; they only appear embedded in free-text prose descriptions. City and state are not shown as structured fields either — the location is only referenced in the page title and prose body text, with no consistent labeled or CSS-selectable element containing just the city or state value.
